title: Add rusqlite dep + SqliteLibrary schema: knowledge_objects, dedup_anchors, citation_edges tables
description:
First Rust implementation issue for SqliteLibrary.

Tasks:
- Add rusqlite (+ rusqlite_migration or inline SQL) to alcanzai-core/Cargo.toml.
- Define SqliteLibrary struct: holds a rusqlite::Connection + open() constructor that creates/migrates the schema.
- Schema (v1 migrations):
  knowledge_objects: id (UUID TEXT PK), content_type TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT, authors TEXT (JSON array), year INTEGER, abstract_text TEXT, provenance TEXT NOT NULL (JSON), dedup_anchors TEXT NOT NULL (JSON), blocks TEXT NOT NULL (JSON array), enrichments TEXT NOT NULL (JSON array), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL.
  dedup_anchors_index: content_hash TEXT UNIQUE, doi TEXT UNIQUE, arxiv_id TEXT UNIQUE, object_id TEXT NOT NULL FK knowledge_objects.id. Separate table for fast O(1) identity lookups without deserializing the full object blob.
  citation_edges: source_id TEXT NOT NULL FK knowledge_objects.id, target_id TEXT NULLABLE (NULL = dangling citation to unknown object), raw_citation TEXT NOT NULL (JSON), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL.
  relationships: id TEXT PK, subject_id TEXT NOT NULL FK, predicate TEXT NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NULLABLE, object_value TEXT NULLABLE, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL.
- Unit tests: open in-memory DB (:memory:), verify all tables exist, verify UNIQUE constraints.

Acceptance criterion: cargo test passes; all four tables exist in the schema; UNIQUE on content_hash/doi/arxiv_id is verified by test.
